chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Isma'il al-Ja'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The divorce of the pregnant woman is one (revocable) divorce; so when she gives birth to what is in her womb, she is definitively divorced from him.

key_terms.وَاحِدَةٌ: One (referring to a single revocable divorce)

ai.seo_question: How many divorces count for a pregnant woman and when does her waiting period end?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that the 'iddah of a pregnant woman concludes upon parturition, a ruling derived from the Quranic verse 65:4. It underscores the principle that the physical act of childbirth serves as the definitive marker for the dissolution of the marital bond, ensuring clarity in lineage and inheritance rights within Shia fiqh.
